answer: Beacon audits plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent registers as one vertex and locks a 500 POA bond. Each epoch a beacon picks 10% of vertices; each pick must answer a heartbeat in 60 seconds. An island identity with no real workload fails and loses its bond. Forging 100 fakes costs 50,000 POA; 10 slashed per epoch bleed 5,000 POA per epoch while costs spiral. An honest agent pays one bond once and keeps its full share.
